subject: Money
title: Wedding Inflation
description: A short lesson to help you apply Wedding Inflation.

hook.text: The average US wedding costs $35,000. In 1980 it was $10,000 adjusted for inflation. What changed?

buildup.text: Social media, Pinterest boards, and reality TV raised expectations. Every wedding competes with every other.

discovery.text: Studies show couples who spend more on weddings have higher divorce rates. The party predicts nothing.

twist.text: The wedding industry profits from social pressure. Venues, photographers, and florists all benchmark upward.

climax.text: A wedding is one day. A marriage is decades. Spending more on the day doesn't invest in the years.

quiz.question: What do studies show about expensive weddings?
options: They correlate with higher divorce rates
